messages:
Marta: Quick follow-up from the all-hands  need a compact framing for ICs and AEs about mission vs roadmap tradeoffs.
Kate (CEO): Short: our north star is production predictability + developer velocity. Prioritize changes that cut variance in latency/cost or remove ops work for customers.
Eli: Practical ask: if a feature helps Hosted now but complicates Dedicated later, what rule do we use?
Kate (CEO): Default: design for portability. If Hosted-only is necessary for speed, require a documented migration path and an owner to carry it across.
Rae: What about competitor messaging? Sales wants a single-sentence rebuttal to "we can just run endpoints ourselves."
Kate (CEO): One-liner: "You can build an endpoint, but you won't get inference-specific primitives (autoscale, KV caching, rollouts, cost suggestions) and the cost predictability we offer out of the box."
Marta: Are we allowed to use cost reduction numbers in outreach?
Kate (CEO): Not without legal/ops signoff. Use qualitative claims and customer vignettes until stats are approved.
Eli: Ops question: typical migration timeline Hosted -> Dedicated?
Rae: From infra notes: Hosted: days to production. Dedicated: weeks for capacity + SLA. Private: months for networking/compliance.
ProductOps Bot: Slides and recording uploaded: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1768123456 :memo:
Marta: I'll draft a 3-line blurb + a sales rebuttal pack and put in #product-playbooks. Thanks everyone.
